meta.name: Loguetown
meta.description: La última isla antes de entrar al Grand Line: Loguetown. Luffy y su tripulación tiran anclas para abastecerse, turistear, y rendir honores al lugar donde Gold Roger dejó su último aliento.

videos.title: Kitetsu III
videos.overview: Touting a fresh bounty issued by Marine HQ, Luffy and co. make landfall at Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed. Being the last stop before the Grand Line, the crew stocks up on supplies and sightsees.

videos.title: Luffy Is Dead
videos.overview: Usopp manages to anger the brat daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Red Hair Pirate Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he offers him a risky way out.

videos.title: The Legend Begins
videos.overview: Luffy arrives at the execution platform, only to be caught in Buggy and Alvida's trap. Sanji and Zoro rush to stop Buggy from poetically—and flashily—executing Luffy where Roger died.
